## The source

- **Sharper bounds for the Chebyshev functions theta(x) and psi(x)** — J. Barkley Rosser, Lowell Schoenfeld. Math. Comp. 29 (1975), 243-269  
  _Classified under the 1970s scheme (MRCLASS 10H05) in the source bibliography; the MSC2020 code recorded here is the modern equivalent, chosen rather than transcribed._
